author: ComplexDataLab
description:
Dataset Card for OpenFake
	

OpenFake is a dataset and benchmark for detecting AI-generated images, with a focus on politically and socially salient content where misinformation risk is highest. It pairs real photographs with synthetic counterparts produced by a wide range of frontier proprietary generators, open-source diffusion models, and community fine-tunes.
